# Sanctyria

> Sanctyria is a dark fantasy universe and creative transmedia ecosystem built around the Eternal Flame.

The website contains the world guide, its eight nations and Flameborn characters, studio work, roadmap, partnerships, and journal articles.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://sanctyria.com/): Introduction to Sanctyria.
- [About](https://sanctyria.com/about): Universe background, terminology, and FAQs.
- [Flameborns](https://sanctyria.com/flameborns): The four elemental avatars.
- [Nations](https://sanctyria.com/nations): The eight nations of Eternia.
- [Studio](https://sanctyria.com/studio): Stories, music, characters, and other media.
- [Journal](https://sanctyria.com/journal): Worldbuilding notes and studio dispatches.
- [Community](https://sanctyria.com/home): Public conversations, creative work, and community discovery.
- [Roadmap](https://sanctyria.com/roadmap): Development phases.
- [Partnerships](https://sanctyria.com/partnership): Collaboration information.
- [Reach Us](https://sanctyria.com/reach-us): Contact and social channels.
